hypothesis: Activation or suspension of a live token-linked capture mechanism changes valuation relative to unaffected control assets.
selection_rule: Events are every effective-dated burn or protocol-capture state change recorded in the mechanism ledger whose full pre and post window lies inside the frozen H2 panel. No event was chosen or dropped from outcomes.

events.announcement_caveat: The UNIfication proposal and vote preceded execution, so the execution-date window can understate an effect that markets priced at proposal or vote time.
Pause discussion may have preceded the effective date recorded in the ledger.

interpretation: Two events with thirty-day windows and eleven-asset placebo pools are exploratory sensitivity evidence about mechanism timing, not causal estimates, price targets, or investment recommendations. Fee co-movement is reported so that a valuation shift is not attributed to capture when usage moved at the same time.

excluded_ledger_changes.reason: Recorded on the first panel day, so no pre-event window exists inside the frozen panel; excluded by the window rule, not by outcome.
